coverage: Read native schematic, board, requirements and check records; independently exported connectivity and matched component values and board pin assignments.
Verified transient models, stimulus, initial operating point and measurement times; decoded supplied waveform data and repeated simulation with a smaller maximum timestep.
Repeated ERC and DRC with schematic parity: zero reported issues. Independently confirmed all five saved track segments are 0.25 mm wide, meeting the 0.20 mm requirement.
Commands, versions, assumptions and outcomes recorded in review-work/circuit/experiments/commands.json and review-work/circuit/experiments/notes.md.

findings.condition: Ideal 0-to-1 V step at /IN, initially discharged C1, no external output load; evaluate /OUT at 1 ms.

evidence.locator: R1 Value at line 1274: 100k; C1 Value at line 955: 100n
R1 Value at line 256: 100k; C1 Value at line 107: 100n
nets: /IN connects J1.1/R1.1; /OUT connects R1.2/C1.1/J1.2; GND connects C1.2/J1.3
Lines 2–7: native R/C values, 1 V stimulus and measurement times

findings.mechanism: The saved 100 kΩ resistor and 100 nF capacitor produce a 10 ms time constant. Consequently, Vout(1 ms) = 1 − exp(−0.001/0.01) = 0.0951626 V.
findings.reasoning: The analytical result, independently decoded supplied waveform and independent ngspice run agree. The output is approximately 0.525 V below the required minimum. This establishes an electrical response defect despite passing ERC, DRC and geometry checks. The 5 ms measurement has no acceptance bound and is not a separate violation.
findings.title: Saved RC values fail the required 1 ms step response

limitations: Tolerance, temperature, loading, ADC sampling, EMI, parasitics, component ratings and hardware behavior were not evaluated.
Zone fill was evaluated as saved; no refill was performed. Disabled ERC/DRC checks remain outside coverage.
No additional shutdown, falling-step or precharged-startup conditions were tested. Active reset and brownout functions are absent from this passive fixture.
Geometry verification establishes track width only, not ampacity or manufacturing capability.
